newsitem.title: USA: America Online names general counsel.
newsitem.headline: America Online names general counsel.

text.p: America Online Inc on Thursday said it named George Vradenburg senior vice president and general counsel.
Vradenburg will report directly to AOL's chief exectuive, Steve Case.
Vradenburg was most recently a senior partner in the Los Angeles office of law firm Latham & Watkins, where he was co-chair of its entertainment and media practice group.
Previously he served as senior vice president and general counsel of CBS Inc and executive vice president of Fox Inc.
The company said Vradenburg's oversight would extend to all of its divisions, including AOL Networks, which manages its flagship online service.

In addition to management of the legal department, Vradenburg will take an active leadership role, helping set AOL's strategy on new-media issues. Among them are making technology available in classrooms, preventing segments of the population from becoming information "have-nots" and using the emerging medium to empower individuals and communities.
The company said he would also become involved in issues such as copyright protection, privacy and freedom of speech.

In January, AOL reached an agreement with the attorneys general of several states to reimburse its online subscribers after receiving complaints that they were unable to gain access the service as promised.
